## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the change, and any related issue. Keep the scope
focused. For documentation, explain what a reader can now understand or reproduce.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you actually ran and their results. For checks
not run, state why. Identify mocked integrations/model replies, synthetic data and
remaining uncertainty. Include a screenshot for a visible UI change when helpful.

## Relevant boundaries

If applicable, explain effects on authorization, project/source isolation, data
transfer/retention, model or device cost, compatibility and rollback. Report a
possible vulnerability privately using [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Vaidehi2510/QA-testbot/blob/main/SECURITY.md) before placing
sensitive details here.

## Contribution notes

Credit other contributors and sources. If AI tools assisted, briefly explain their
role and how you checked the result. Do not include private prompts or source.

- [ ] I reviewed the change and removed secrets/private data.
- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Vaidehi2510/QA-testbot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [code of conduct](https://github.com/Vaidehi2510/QA-testbot/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] I described verification honestly, including checks not run.
- [ ] I retained relevant third-party copyright/license notices.
